channel.title: Financials and holding companies: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the financials and holding companies sector.

item.title: HDC Holdings: HDC subsidiary IPARK Hyundai Development won a KRW 350.1bn construction contract for Jinju Dodong Block B apartments from affiliate IPARK I&Cons.
Lotte Non-Life Insurance: Lotte Non-Life Insurance shares suspended from trading on 19 November 2026 at 16:49 over a capital reduction of 10% or more; trading resumes 20 November.
Lotte Non-Life Insurance: Lotte Non-Life Insurance's board decided a 90% bonus capital reduction, cutting par value per share from KRW 1,000 to KRW 100.
item.description: 90% capital reduction, no share count change

item.title: Hana 33 Special Purpose Acquisition Company: Hana 33 Special Purpose Acquisition Company common shares suspended from trading on 2026-11-19 after a delisting reason arose.
Yuanta 16 Special Purpose Acquisition Company: Yuanta 16 Special Purpose Acquisition Company warned of delisting if no merger listing review application is filed by November 25, 2026.
SK Securities No.12 Special Purpose Acquisition Company: SK Securities No.12 SPAC warned of delisting if it misses the 25 November 2026 deadline for its merger listing preliminary review application
NAU IB Capital: KOSDAQ halts trading in NAU IB Capital common shares from November 20, 2026 due to a reverse stock split.
Kolon: Kolon subsidiary Kolon Global won a KRW 77.7bn construction contract for Simmtech's Cheongju 2 plant, equal to 2.89% of revenue.
Kolmar Holdings: Kolmar Holdings reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 134.5bn and operating profit of KRW 19.5bn, provisional and unaudited.
Hanwha General Insurance: Hanwha General Insurance reported Q3 2026 operating profit of KRW 114.7bn, up 23.6% year on year, with net income of KRW 96.1bn.
Dongwon Industries: Dongwon Industries reported Q3 2026 separate revenue of KRW 273.3bn and operating profit of KRW 12.5bn, with a net loss.
Hecto Financial: Hecto Financial reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 52.6bn, up 14.9% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 4.8bn.
Hankook & Company: Hankook & Company reported Q3 2026 consolidated operating profit of KRW 66.5bn, down 51.5% year on year.
Organic Tea Cosmetics Holdings Company: Organic Tea Cosmetics decided on a third-party allotment of 50,000,000 new common shares at KRW 2,025 each, raising KRW 101.25bn.
Hyundai G.F. Holdings: Hyundai G.F. Holdings reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1.97tn and operating profit of KRW 65.3bn.
AK Holdings: AK Holdings subsidiary AKIS signed a KRW 3.42bn AIRBRS upgrade contract with Incheon International Airport Corporation.
Hyosung: Hyosung Investment & Development, a Hyosung subsidiary, signed a real estate lease worth KRW 34.0m, 7.37% of recent revenue.
Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings: Kim Dong-seon becomes largest shareholder of Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings with 32.99% of common shares after a tender offer on 2026-11-04.
Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings: Hanwha Machinery & Services Holdings' largest shareholder changed to Kim Dong-seon (75.51% with 6 others) after a tender offer settled on 2026-11-04.
BGF: BGF reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 130.7bn and operating profit of KRW 24.0bn, down 10.4% year on year.
GS P&L: GS P&L reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 166.1bn and operating profit of KRW 41.3bn, up 107.3% year on year.
Poongsan Holdings: Poongsan Holdings reported Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated operating revenue of KRW 132.4bn (132,404 million won), up 28.7% year on year.
Poongsan Holdings: Poongsan Holdings reported Q3 2026 preliminary separate operating revenue of KRW 51.0bn and operating profit of KRW 6.5bn.
SNT Holdings: SNT Holdings reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 454.6bn and operating profit of KRW 45.1bn, both down year on year.
Dong-A Pharmaceutical: Subsidiary Dong-A ST received Korean MFDS approval on 2026-10-30 for Stillen Q Tab, a once-daily acute/chronic gastritis treatment.
item.description: MFDS approval of Stillen Q Tab
